heldout_policy: All image position, velocity and motion gate targets on these frames excluded from fitting; temporal priors may update them
finger_update_temporal_semantics: Per-hand normalized first/second differences of the added masked finger correction include active/inactive boundaries; inactive values stay at baseline. Independently observed wrist-relative fast motion relaxes the penalty; no missing image targets or baseline trajectory smoothing are introduced.
support_transition_semantics: Opt-in bounded cosine correction collar outside original admitted support; no independent image coordinates are added. Both original and expanded support boundaries remain reported. Zero collar reproduces the previous support policy.
correction_velocity_budget_semantics: Opt-in loss on every modified edge: unknown wrist-relative finger correction steps above 1 pixel or 0.005 native estimated metres, or training-observed velocity discrepancy above baseline*1.05+0.25 pixels. Optional wrist-chain correction receives corresponding wrist bounds. Mean plus worst-edge loss discourages dilution on long clips; independent post-fit checks remain required.
correction_budget_safety_semantics: An optional fraction in (0,1] tightens only the internal training budgets: fraction pixels, fraction*0.005 native estimated metres, and baseline*1.05+fraction*0.25 observed-velocity pixels. The loss curvature and independent diagnostic thresholds remain unchanged; no held-out or missing image targets enter training.

support_boundary_motion.interpretation: Prediction-only support-boundary steps relative to each wrist, not reference-relative ACC or verified physical motion
support_boundary_motion.independent_motion_evidence: Full independent observations are used only after fitting for this report; accepted adjacent fingers require both accepted wrists and both accepted finger observations

original_support_boundary_motion.interpretation: Prediction-only support-boundary steps relative to each wrist, not reference-relative ACC or verified physical motion
original_support_boundary_motion.independent_motion_evidence: Full independent observations are used only after fitting for this report; accepted adjacent fingers require both accepted wrists and both accepted finger observations

before.interpretation: Contact agreement with an uncertain RGB-derived object hypothesis, not true contact or official PEN

after.interpretation: Contact agreement with an uncertain RGB-derived object hypothesis, not true contact or official PEN

actual_hand_skin_penetration_before.interpretation: Actual native hand-skin vertex depth inside the uncertain reconstructed convex object; not volume, hidden-reference error or official PEN

limitations: Camera fixed; only bounded selected arm/wrist controls change
Reliability weights are not calibrated visibility probabilities
Image landmark agreement and smoother motion do not establish hidden-reference accuracy

independent_observation_provenance.mirror_gate: When enabled, preserve original observed pixels only where flip-then-unflip point discrepancy <=6 original pixels; reject hand median discrepancy >4 pixels or fewer than5 supported points. No target smoothing/interpolation.
independent_observation_provenance.confidence_semantics: Binary fitting weights, NOT probabilities. Requires model detection, SAM-wrist association, nonduplicate side assignment, local color support and any enabled handedness/mirror gates. Missing/ambiguous/unsupported joints weight 0.
independent_observation_provenance.visibility_limit: MediaPipe returns no per-joint visibility/confidence. Broad YCrCb color support is a heuristic, may reject visible skin or accept skin-colored objects. Occluded predictions are not verified evidence.
independent_observation_provenance.handedness_semantics: Anatomical side assigned by nearest original SAM wrist, not selfie handedness class. Classification scores stored separately, not used as observation confidence.
independent_observation_provenance.crop_semantics: Externally frozen source-pixel crops shared with the specialist observer. Targets remain raw detector pixels; no target interpolation or confidence calibration.
independent_observation_provenance.haMeR_handflow_status: Not run: licensed MANO_RIGHT.pkl absent in verified local inventory; no license-bypassing model-buffer reconstruction attempted.
independent_observation_provenance.data_policy: Only the explicit Track 1 source video and its own SAM crop seeds. Generic public model, no additional challenge data.

observation_semantics: Independent MediaPipe image landmarks on source-bound crops; reliability weights are not per-joint probabilities or measured visibility
intrinsics_status: received MoGe2 pinhole estimate in original integer pixel centers, not measured calibration

object_report.source: Verified EP16 RGB, own SAM2 masks and original fixed native-MHR wrist depth gauge
object_report.scale_assumption: Original fixed SAM native wrists, RGB-reviewed stable carry90..230inclusive excluding everyfifth originalframe, pooledmedian. No A/B output/contact-residual tuning. Object-center≈wrist-depth is an explicit uncertain monocular gauge assumption.
object_report.mesh_assumption: Own RGB-derived n16 symmetric profile; hidden shape and physical scale unverified. Analytic trig zeros corrected before geometry is generated.
object_report.coordinate_convention: OpenCV right/down/forward metres; fixed current human K; one baked mesh scale, no per-frame mesh scale.
object_report.initialization_note: Per-frame silhouette log-size is converted into rigid depth before export. It is an initializer, not final contact pose.

temporal_refinement.optimization: Joint 360-frame Lie-rotation/metric-translation least squares with original RGB SIFT training pixels, mask contours, cross-frame rotation/translation priors and weak assumed-depth anchor. No direct pose filtering.
temporal_refinement.heldout: Reference SIFT query IDs divisible by5 excluded from pose objective; homography gate estimated from training matches only. These validate pixel tracking conditional on the hypothesized mesh, not true 3D or scale.

phases.annotation_method: Conservative source-RGB-only manual phase annotation, independently reviewed before A/B fitting. Contact information is not inferred from fitted geometry or model residuals.

phase_intervals_inclusive.evidence: Early contact/first touch is not temporally localized; no attraction in this complete interval.
Source RGB samples show airborne object carried with both hands. This admits a soft coarse grasp hypothesis, not measured fingertip contact.
Object is being placed and hands withdraw near285; exact release times and sliding contact are uncertain. All attraction is disabled.
Inspected RGB290/300/330/359 shows hands separated from the resting object.

phases.depth_gauge_frame_policy: Root-frozen object preparation uses only original SAM native wrists on frame IDs not divisible by5 within90..230; body geometry and depth remain estimates. This is not an independently calibrated object scale.
phases.manual_phase_weight_semantics: The active phase weight1 is multiplied by the existing8-frame boundary ramp and the fixed object-pose reliability gate. Root-frozen global contact anchor weight.01 and tip-penetration proxy weight.005 remain separate.
limitations: Specific fingertip contact identities and surface anchor locations are not observed through occlusion.

A soft object-local anchor is an engineering prior; no-slip and constant contact correspondences throughout carrying are unverified. Do not interpret this label as an instruction to clamp every finger.
Only preexisting near-surface eligible tips may be admitted under a separately frozen geometric gate; no new image observations are created.
Current MHR human and object share estimated camera/relative-scale gauge; physical metric scale and hidden geometry remain unaccepted.
Phase annotation is shared reconstruction evidence, not independent ground truth or official challenge scoring data.
The solver must keep exactly the same native mutable-variable mask in A andB; lack of MP support is not measured physical occlusion.

contact_provenance.scale_interpretation: Local mesh scaled at fixed pose; geometry stress test changes projected silhouette
contact_provenance.uncertainty: The sensitivity range is chosen, not a calibrated confidence interval; shape/backside and metric scale remain hypotheses

mesh_change_from_baseline_mm.interpretation: Change from baseline prediction, not error against true geometry
